meta.name: security-engineering
meta.description: Comprehensive security reference for this project — not a checklist, a methodology. Covers how to threat-model new features, the trust boundaries in this specific architecture, a vulnerability playbook with real-world breach examples mapped to this stack, an in-depth section on AI agent tool-use safety and prompt injection (critical given the store-admin agent's refund/discount tools), a concrete testing toolkit, an incident response playbook, and a gap-hunting framework for finding issues not on any list. Use this for any security review, before any deployment, and whenever a new feature introduces a new input source, tool, or trust boundary.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按安全方法论审查项目,而非逐条打勾:它会对每个新功能做威胁建模,检查信任边界,并参照真实漏洞案例测试;发现提示注入、密钥泄露等问题时,会给出架构级修复建议(如工具隔离、参数化查询)。还提供测试工具、事件响应与缺口寻找框架。
howto.when: 在用户要求进行安全审查、部署前,或新功能引入新的输入源、工具、信任边界时触发。

say.text: 对订单导出功能做安全审查,重点查 IDOR 和注入。
say.note: Claude 会按方法论逐项检查并给出修复建议。

say.text: 我集成了新的支付回调解码功能,帮我做威胁建模。
say.note: 会分析输入源、信任边界和攻击面。

say.text: 部署前审查下当前代码,查找敏感信息和权限绕过。
say.note: 会运行 gitleaks 等测试并生成报告。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude threat-models new features, maps trust boundaries, tests against real breach examples, proposes fixes (tool isolation, parameterized queries). Includes test tools, IR, gap hunting.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any security review, before any deployment, or when a new feature introduces a new input source, tool, or trust boundary.

say_en.text: Do a security review of the order export feature, focusing on IDOR and injection.
say_en.note: Runs through the methodology and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: I integrated a new payment webhook decoder; help me threat-model it.
say_en.note: Analyzes input sources, trust boundaries, attack surface.

say_en.text: Before deploy, review the current code for leaked secrets and privilege bypass.
say_en.note: Runs tools like gitleaks and generates a report.
